name: Kanban Modals
description: The conversation describes the process of extracting four modals from a `Kanban.vue` file into separate Vue components. These extracted components include the New/Edit Board Modal, Add/Edit Column Modal, Import Task Modal, and File Finder Modal, each with its own structure comprising template and script sections. Each component manages its specific functionality with data, computed properties, and methods, enhancing modularity and maintainability. This approach simplifies the main `Kanban.vue` file by isolating modal logic into distinct components.

messages.content: Extract all modals content and create a component for each of them with the logic.
